source.paraphrase: Every EXPO_PUBLIC_ variable is inlined into the client bundle. A secret-shaped name with that prefix is a published secret.

invariants.why: The bundle ships to every install, so a public token or service key in it is readable by anyone who downloads the app.
invariants.fixHint: Keep secrets server-side and expose only an endpoint. Keep EXPO_PUBLIC_ names to URLs, ids, and feature flags.
invariants.avoid: Renaming the binding on destructure does not rename the variable. The EXPO_PUBLIC_ name still ships.

source.work: Expo docs, Linking and Expo Go
source.paraphrase: exp:// URLs point at the Expo Go development channel. Shipped code links through the registered app scheme.

invariants.why: A leftover dev URL opens Expo Go or a dead tunnel on a user device instead of the screen the link promised.
invariants.fixHint: Open myapp:// routes through the registered scheme, and resolve the host from config rather than a dev tunnel.
invariants.avoid: Building the exp:// URL from a template hides the scheme from a literal search but opens the same dev channel.

source.paraphrase: Route names are a static set the navigator types check. Concatenating them builds names no type and no deep link can verify.

invariants.why: A computed route name bypasses the typed route map, so a rename compiles and then navigates nowhere at runtime.
invariants.fixHint: Navigate with a literal route name and pass the varying value as a param object.
invariants.avoid: A template literal with no plus sign is still concatenation. The type checker still cannot see the final name.

source.work: React Navigation docs, params and state persistence
source.paraphrase: Navigation params persist in navigation state and deep-link URLs. Secret-shaped values travel as ids loaded server-side instead.

invariants.why: Params survive in state dumps, logs, and shared links, so a token param leaks the session wherever the state goes.
invariants.fixHint: Pass an order or session id and load the secret value from the server on the destination screen.
invariants.avoid: Bundling the secret as credentials or a session object does not change what the param carries.
